credentials.description: API key (Authorization: App <key>); keys have an expiry date and can be revoked
your account's base URL, https://xxxxx.api.infobip.com, shown in the Infobip API Resource hub — it identifies the account, the key authenticates it
`from` of each message: your registered WhatsApp sender number, in international format

example_prompt: Reply to a customer on WhatsApp with a text message through Infobip inside the 24-hour customer service window.

from.description: Registered WhatsApp sender number. Must be in international format and comply with [WhatsApp's requirements](https://www.infobip.com/docs/whatsapp/get-started/sender-registration#phone-number-what-you-need-to-know).

to.description: Message recipient number in international format or WhatsApp business-scoped user ID.

messageId.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the message sent.

content.description: The content object to build a message that will be sent.

text.description: Content of the message being sent.

previewUrl.description: Allows for URL preview from within the message. If set to `true`, the message content must contain a URL starting with `https://` or `http://` and the flag removeProtocol must be set to `false`.

callbackData.description: Custom client data that will be included in a [Delivery Report](#channels/whatsapp/receive-whatsapp-delivery-reports).

notifyUrl.description: The URL on your callback server to which delivery and seen reports will be sent. [Delivery report format](#channels/whatsapp/receive-whatsapp-delivery-reports), [Seen report format](#channels/whatsapp/receive-whatsapp-seen-reports).

shortenUrl.description: Enable shortening of the URLs within a message. Set this to `true`, if you want to set up other URL options.

trackClicks.description: Enable tracking of short URL clicks within a message: which URL was clicked, how many times, and by whom.

trackingUrl.description: The URL of your callback server on to which the Click report will be sent.

removeProtocol.description: Remove a protocol, such as `https://`, from links to shorten a message. Note that some mobiles may not recognize such links as a URL.

customDomain.description: Select a predefined custom domain to use when generating a short URL.

entityId.description: Required for entity use in a send request for outbound traffic. Returned in notification events. For more details, see our [documentation](https://www.infobip.com/docs/cpaas-x/application-and-entity-management).

applicationId.description: Required for application use in a send request for outbound traffic. Returned in notification events. For more details, see our [documentation](https://www.infobip.com/docs/cpaas-x/application-and-entity-management).

context.description: Context object to define WhatsApp-specific metadata about a message.

replyToMessageId.description: Inbound message ID used for a reply. Contextual bubble will not appear for template messages.

to.description: The destination address of the message.

messageCount.description: Number of messages required to deliver.

messageId.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the message sent. If not passed, it will be automatically generated and returned in a response.

status.description: Indicates the [status](https://www.infobip.com/docs/essentials/response-status-and-error-codes#api-status-codes) of the message and how to recover from an error should there be any.

action.description: Action that should be taken to eliminate the error.

gotchas: Send the API key as 'Authorization: App <API_KEY>' — the prefix App; Bearer is only for OAuth 2.0 access tokens. Infobip API keys have a predefined expiry date and can be revoked at any time; a missing or invalid credential answers 401.
The OpenAPI lists these API key scopes for this endpoint (x-scopes): message:send, whatsapp:message:send, whatsapp:manage. Give the key a matching scope when you create it.

Each Infobip account has its own base URL, xxxxx.api.infobip.com, shown once you log in to the Infobip API Resource hub. Set it in INFOBIP_BASE_URL (https://xxxxx.api.infobip.com in this spec is a placeholder). It identifies your account, the API key authenticates it.
A text message is only delivered if the recipient contacted the business within the last 24 hours; otherwise send a template (send_whatsapp_template).
from is your registered WhatsApp sender number in international format; to is the recipient's number in international format (or a WhatsApp business-scoped user ID).
The response doesn't contain the final delivery status: delivery (and seen) reports go to notifyUrl per message, or to an account-level URL set up by Infobip support.
Errors on this endpoint are { requestError: { serviceException: { messageId, text, validationErrors } } } — not the errorCode shape of the SMS v3 endpoints.
A 429 means the endpoint's rate limit was hit; limits differ per endpoint. Retry with exponential backoff and honour the Retry-After header when present.
